fields.statement: QA cycle 2, hands-on with rhiza built from this branch at c57d3a309 (go build into the session scratchpad), in a scratch Rhiza root with a project repo, a local bare origin, real git, a fake rex/claude and a scripted gh logging calls (pr view fails, pr create prints a URL), with no RHIZA_TEST_NOW so the model-branch step is live: rhiza run start --foreground --workflow plan --new 'Plan reports' (and again with --milestone) succeeded; the open entry in the main checkout was byte-identical to the one in ../repo.<slug> and committed at the run branch's HEAD with a clean worktree; rhiza change show of the new change set worked from main; rhiza check printed ok with no untracked-entry warning and rhiza health's main part was 'ok ... 2 untracked log entries pending on a model branch or run'. No model/* branch reached origin and gh was never called (the cycle 1 spurious model PR is gone).

QA cycle 2, hands-on with rhiza built from this branch at c57d3a309 (go build into the session scratchpad), in a scratch Rhiza root with a project repo, a local bare origin, real git, a fake rex/claude and a scripted gh logging calls (pr view fails, pr create prints a URL), with no RHIZA_TEST_NOW so the model-branch step is live: after removing a finished plan run's worktree, rhiza check in the main checkout exited 0, printed ok and 'warn log .rhiza/log/<cs>/<entry>.json: untracked log entry that no model branch or live run holds' with 'next: rhiza model commit-untracked'; while the run's linked worktree existed, and for entries on a pushed model branch, it printed no such warning.

QA cycle 2, hands-on with rhiza built from this branch at c57d3a309 (go build into the session scratchpad), in a scratch Rhiza root with a project repo, a local bare origin, real git, a fake rex/claude and a scripted gh logging calls (pr view fails, pr create prints a URL), with no RHIZA_TEST_NOW so the model-branch step is live: with that orphan, rhiza health exited 1 with 'bad main ... 1 untracked log entries on no branch, 2 ... pending on a model branch or run', naming the entry, its change set and rhiza model commit-untracked, and listing the run-held and model-branch-held entries as pending; after commit-untracked the main part was ok with 3 pending.

QA cycle 2, hands-on with rhiza built from this branch at c57d3a309 (go build into the session scratchpad), in a scratch Rhiza root with a project repo, a local bare origin, real git, a fake rex/claude and a scripted gh logging calls (pr view fails, pr create prints a URL), with no RHIZA_TEST_NOW so the model-branch step is live: rhiza change new 'Main write' in the main checkout with no live run kept the entry in main's log and pushed model/<full cs ID>-<full entry ID> to origin, cut from origin/main and holding exactly that one entry, and ran gh pr create --base main --head that branch once; the temporary worktree was gone afterwards (git worktree list).

QA cycle 2, hands-on with rhiza built from this branch at c57d3a309 (go build into the session scratchpad), in a scratch Rhiza root with a project repo, a local bare origin, real git, a fake rex/claude and a scripted gh logging calls (pr view fails, pr create prints a URL), with no RHIZA_TEST_NOW so the model-branch step is live: with one orphan entry of a change set whose plan worktree was removed, rhiza model commit-untracked printed 'change set <cs>: committed 1 entries on a model branch', pushed model/<cs>-<entry> to origin and called gh pr create once, leaving the run-held and model-branch-held entries untouched (no second branch or PR for them).
